summary: Bridgford Foods Corp filed an Item 8.01 Form 8-K on September 30, 2026, disclosing a 45-day extension of its Wells Fargo revolving line of credit maturity to November 13, 2026, on existing terms. The facility permits borrowings up to $7.5 million at the bank's prime rate or SOFR plus 2.0%, with a 0.25% unused commitment fee. This is a routine credit-facility amendment, not a special situation; no deal terms, board recommendation, or advisor were disclosed. Watch for a permanent refinancing or further extension as the new maturity nears.
